facts.business: The company manufactures and distributes engineered quartz and artificial stones through facilities in Jaipur, India and Dubai, UAE, with a US distribution subsidiary.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Prior year audited by another auditor who expressed unmodified opinion; current auditor's opinion not modified

key_risks: Tariff uncertainty on India-origin quartz exports to the US
EBITDA turned negative at INR (113) million with Q4 margin of (41.85)%
US subsidiary revenue declined 48.6% due to elevated tariffs and trade policy uncertainties
Working capital pressure with inventory and receivables fluctuations
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions conducted in ordinary course of business at arm's length; no material changes in subsidiary business nature; Superior Surfaces Inc. (50% held US subsidiary) and Global Surfaces Inc. (US subsidiary) are related parties
